purpose: Future setup and materialization contract only; this file does not provide a runner and no scenario has been executed.

placeholder_policy.path_rewrite: Rebase future oracle-runs/cli-matrix paths under one fresh ignored run root without modifying checked-in vectors.

path.policy: Construct PATH from target-specific absolute entries for the pinned JMeter launcher, pinned Java runtime, and minimal required system tools; do not use a POSIX path list on Windows or inherit the host PATH.

locale.windows_rule: Use target-supported JVM locale properties instead of injecting unsupported POSIX variables; record the resulting OS and JVM locale.

output_directories.name: load-test-results
output_directories.prelaunch: create parent under the fresh evidence root and ensure the result file is absent
output_directories.postlaunch: retain only bounded evidence under the same run root

output_directories.name: report-output-empty
output_directories.prelaunch: materialize an absent or empty output directory under the fresh evidence root; do not reuse a prior run
output_directories.postlaunch: bound report entries by max_report_entries and retain output only under the run root

output_directories.name: report-output-nonempty-rejection
output_directories.prelaunch: create the directory and one deterministic sentinel file before launch; do not assert the rejection until the oracle run
output_directories.postlaunch: record whether the sentinel and directory were preserved; never delete outside the owned run root

output_directories.name: report-output-force-replacement
output_directories.prelaunch: create a nonempty directory with a deterministic sentinel file so -f has a real replacement target
output_directories.postlaunch: record replacement behavior and keep cleanup bounded to the owned run root

output_directories.name: log-files
output_directories.prelaunch: create the parent directory and use a fresh path; preserve the quoted date pattern as one argv token
output_directories.postlaunch: bound log bytes by max_log_bytes and normalize only declared temporary fields

process_lifecycle.ownership: Every launched client, server, registry, and worker must have an exact runner-owned child handle.
process_lifecycle.before_signal: call try_wait on the exact child and never signal an exited child
process_lifecycle.shutdown: request graceful shutdown through the fixture protocol, wait with the bounded deadline, then escalate only to the still-live direct child
process_lifecycle.reap: wait and reap each exact child on success, error, timeout, and cancellation
process_lifecycle.broad_cleanup: forbidden; never discover or terminate processes by name, PID scans, labels, images, users, or ancestors

server_mode.setup: launch the server as an owned child and record a deterministic local readiness transition
server_mode.shutdown: use the owned child handle and the same bounded graceful/direct-child policy; do not leave a long-lived server behind

local_rmi_setup.registry: runner-owned local registry and worker only
local_rmi_setup.remote_hosts: materialize remote_hosts for -r from the runner-owned loopback worker; -R receives the materialized loopback host and port
local_rmi_setup.remote_hosts_property_source: Copy the checked-in primary property input into the fresh run root and add the runner-assigned loopback host for -r, or use an equivalent explicitly recorded property injection; never modify the checked-in input or rely on an ambient jmeter.properties file.
local_rmi_setup.port_materialization: replace <registry-port> with a runner-assigned loopback port and record it; do not depend on a fixed host port
local_rmi_setup.readiness: bounded local readiness handshake before the client starts
local_rmi_setup.worker_shutdown: wait for the client shutdown request and worker outcome separately, then reap the exact worker and registry children

unavailable_registry_setup.materialization: use a loopback endpoint with no runner-owned listener, verify absence at setup, and record the selected port
unavailable_registry_setup.process_discovery: forbidden; do not scan or terminate an unrelated listener
unavailable_registry_setup.expected_status: remote-or-fatal-deferred; process_exit remains null until observed

stop_failure_setup.induction: A future bounded harness must deliberately keep one owned worker/thread live through the immediate-stop deadline. The checked-in CLI plan does not induce this condition.
stop_failure_setup.comparison: Run both property values against the identical harness and compare local process, worker, and diagnostic fields separately.

observation_rules.process_exit: Retain and compare the exact child integer only when observed; static descriptors keep it null and unasserted.
observation_rules.sample_status: Compare sample success/failure separately from client and worker process status.
observation_rules.raw_artifacts: none in this static corpus; future bounded artifacts belong below the ignored evidence root
